title: Index top-level variables and constants
description:
Agents hit this gap: sutra_grep can't find module-level variables because they aren't indexed. Rust top-level const/static are indexed, but Dart top-level variables are not. Becomes more important as more languages are added (C globals, Python module-level assignments).

Scope: extend Dart parser to extract top-level variable declarations as Const-kind symbols. Verify Rust coverage of static items. Add to the adding-languages doc as a requirement for new adapters.

Small effort, real agent UX improvement.
execution_record: Implemented as planned. Three changes: (1) `extract_variable_symbols` helper in dart.rs handles both `top_level_variable_declaration` and `declaration` (class field) nodes, walking `static_final_declaration_list` and `initialized_identifier_list` to extract each variable; (2) `extract_language_attrs` gained a `Const | Static` branch emitting is_const/is_final/is_static/is_late; (3) adding-languages.md updated with variable extraction as a requirement. Rust parser already had full const/static coverage — no changes needed. 5 new tests, all 558 tests pass.

messages.author: codex
messages.text: Codex review: approve with notes. One real finding (medium): tree-sitter-dart uses `identifier_list` for abstract and external field declarations, which `extract_variable_symbols` didn't handle. Fixed in 51c0112.
